## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长计算

**出处**：`press_release.txt` 位置 3115，以及 `financial_statements.txt` 位置 8877 和 19278

| 项目 | FY26 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2026) | FY25 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2025) |
|------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | **$39,306 百万** | **$29,878 百万** |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{YoY 同比增长} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100 = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100 \approx 31.56\%$$

管理层在 `press_release.txt`（位置 3115）中披露为 **32%**（报告口径），恒定汇率下为 **31%**。差异来自四舍五入以及汇率影响（恒定汇率影响 $80 百万）。

---

### 2. 管理层在电话会上对增长的归因（原文引用）

**出处**：`transcript.txt` 位置 24808–24830（Satya Nadella & Amy Hood 的 prepared remarks）

管理层将 Intelligent Cloud 32% 的增长归因于以下几个因素：

**① Azure 强劲增长（43%）——产能与效率驱动**
> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."*

**② GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**
> *"Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."*

**③ 内部服务器（On-premises server）续约收入在本期确认**
> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."*

**④ 共享 R&D 投资带来的运营杠杆（运营费用仅增 10%，而收入增 32%）**
> *"Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."*

---

### 3. 归因分类：已发生事实 vs. 未来前瞻性表述

以下逐条标注，并说明区分依据：

| # | 归因内容 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---------|------|---------|
| ① | Azure 收入增长 43%，客户持续需求超过可用产能 | **已发生事实** | 使用过去时态："revenue grew"、"demand continues to exceed"（"continues" 在此描述季度内持续存在的状态），"was ahead of expectations"、"was quickly monetized" 均为已实现的事件描述 |
| ② | CPU/GPU 集群效率提升 + 流程改进使新产能提前交付 | **已发生事实** | "driven by efficiency gains" 和 "process improvements to enable earlier delivery" 解释了本季度已发生的超预期增长的原因，使用过去式描述 |
| ③ | 额外的 Azure 产能被快速变现 | **已发生事实** | "was quickly monetized" — 过去时态，明确指本季度已发生的变现 |
| ④ | GitHub Copilot 消费强于预期（6月商业模式变更后） | **已发生事实** | "benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" — 已实现的消费结果；"June business model change" 是已发生的事件 |
| ⑤ | 内部服务器续约在本期确认更多收入 | **已发生事实** | "were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — 描述已确认的本期收入 |
| ⑥ | 共享 R&D 投资（运营费用增长 10%） | **已发生事实** | "Operating expenses increased 10%" — 已实现的财务数据 |
| ⑦ | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻性表述** | "remain focused on" 表示管理层当前及未来的行动方向；"bridge the gaps" 指未来要做的事 |
| ⑧ | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | "we continue to expect" 明确是未来预期 |
| ⑨ | "Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" | **前瞻性表述** | "we expect" 明确的未来指引 |

**区分依据总结**：
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态（grew, was, were, benefited, increased）或描述已确认/已实现的状态；对应已发布的季度数据（Q4 FY26）。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "expect"、"we continue to expect"、"remain focused on"、"will" 等词，对应 FY27 Q1 的指引或未来趋势判断，描述的是尚未发生的事件或管理层的未来意图。

---

**结论**：Intelligent Cloud 分部 FY26 Q4 收入同比增长约 **32%**（报告口径），核心驱动力是 Azure 43% 的增长（产能效率 + 提前变现）、GitHub Copilot 消费超预期、以及内部服务器续约的本期收入确认。管理层同时对 FY27 上半年和 Azure 下季度增长保持乐观预期，属于前瞻性指引。
